title: Regex Patterns Add Few Edges Next to Co-occurrence
subtitle: Edges from each extractor on three open-access papers, before merging and before GraphBuilder drops edges
caption: Pattern edges are 1 to 14 per paper against 44 to 190 co-occurrence edges. Each pattern needs a single word on either side of the verb, so multi-word or hyphenated entities such as NF-kB or A549 cells cannot match whole. Pattern edges that hit an existing co-occurrence pair replace its edge type.
source: results/pipeline_measurements.json, from scripts/measure_pipeline.py, single run per paper
